requirements: A node with dependsOn IDs may be scheduled only in a batch strictly after every eligible dependency has been scheduled.
Respect options.maxBatchWeight when provided. Node weight defaults to 1. The sum of node weights in a batch must not exceed maxBatchWeight.
If an eligible canary has an eligible unresolved dependency, throw an Error because the canary-first and dependency-order constraints cannot both be satisfied.
If no remaining node is schedulable because of unresolved or cyclic dependencies, throw an Error.
Preserve deterministic input order among currently feasible nodes.
